sentences.zh: 署安徽布政使，至則清釐田賦，杜絕欺隱，增墾田萬八千餘畝，撙節庫儲至二百萬金。

translations.literal: He acted as Anhui treasurer; on arrival he cleared land tax, stopped fraud and concealment, increased reclaimed land by more than eighteen thousand mu, and economized treasury storage to two million taels.
translations.idiomatic: As acting Anhui treasurer he cleared land tax fraud, added more than eighteen thousand mu of reclaimed land, and built treasury reserves to two million taels.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，德人索膠州灣，又脅朝廷罷李秉衡，廕霖奮然曰：「是尚可為國乎！」

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Germans demanded Jiaozhou Bay and also forced the court to dismiss Li Bingheng; Yinlin said angrily: "Can the state still be saved?"
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty-three Germany seized Jiaozhou Bay and forced Li Bingheng's dismissal; Yu cried, "Can this state still be saved?"

sentences.zh: 上疏極論王大臣不職，因附陳修省五事，不報。

translations.literal: He memorialized fiercely on the unfitness of princes and ministers and appended five items for provincial reform; no reply came.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized fiercely on incompetent ministers and proposed five reforms for the provinces; the court did not answer.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，擢湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was promoted to governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty-four made him Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 之洞為總督，頗主泰西新法，廕霖龂龂爭議，以為：「救時之計，在正人心、辨學術，若用夷變夏，恐異日之憂愈大。」

translations.literal: Zhidong was governor-general and strongly favored Western new methods; Yinlin argued sharply, holding: "The plan to save the time lies in rectifying hearts and distinguishing learning; if barbarian ways replace Chinese ways, I fear tomorrow's troubles will be greater."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong as governor-general pushed Western reforms; Yu argued that saving the age required rectifying hearts and scholarship, and that replacing Chinese ways with foreign ones would deepen tomorrow's troubles.

sentences.zh: 之洞意迂之，然仗其清正，使治吏事。

translations.literal: Zhidong thought him obstinate but relied on his integrity and had him manage official affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang thought him stubborn but trusted his integrity for administrative work.

sentences.zh: 湖北財賦倚釐金，廕霖精心綜核，以舉劾為激揚，歲入驟增數十萬。

translations.literal: Hubei's revenue relied on likin; Yinlin carefully audited it, using promotion and punishment as incentive, and annual receipts suddenly increased by several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei revenue depended on likin; Yu audited it carefully, using promotion and dismissal as leverage, and annual receipts jumped by hundreds of thousands of taels.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，調撫河南。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was transferred to govern Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty-seven transferred him to Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 時兩宮西狩，德、法兵日謀南下，而河北莠民往往仇殺教民，廕霖檄彰衛懷道馮光元捕誅首惡數人。

translations.literal: At the time the two palaces were on western tour and German and French troops daily planned to move south; in Hebei many bad fellows often killed Christians in revenge; Yinlin ordered Feng Guangyuan of Zhangwei and Huaidao to capture and execute the ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: While the empress dowagers toured the west and German and French armies threatened the south, Hebei mobs killed Christians; Yu ordered Feng Guangyuan to execute the ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 德、法兵至順德，聞教案已結，乃還。

translations.literal: When German and French troops reached Shunde and heard the missionary case was settled, they returned.
translations.idiomatic: German and French troops reached Shunde, learned the missionary case was closed, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，調湖北。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was transferred to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty-eight returned him to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 會詔裁缺，改廣西。

translations.literal: When an edict cut posts, he was changed to Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the court cut posts he was shifted to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 廷議廕霖不善外交，复降旨開缺，假居南陽。

translations.literal: Court discussion held that Yinlin was poor at foreign affairs; another edict removed him from office and he lived temporarily at Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Officials judged Yu poor at diplomacy; another edict removed him and he lived at Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 三十年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in year thirty.

sentences.zh: 廕霖晚歲益潛心儒先性理書，雖已貴，服食不改儒素，硃子書不離案側，時皆稱之。

translations.literal: In his later years Yinlin devoted himself still more to the Neo-Confucian masters' books on nature and principle; though already honored, his food and dress did not change from scholar's simplicity, Zhu Xi's books never left his desk, and the age all praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In later years Yu immersed himself in Neo-Confucian texts; though honored, he dressed and ate as a plain scholar, kept Zhu Xi on his desk, and won universal praise.

sentences.zh: 饒應祺，字子維，湖北恩施人。

translations.literal: Rao Yingqi, style name Ziwei, was a native of Enshi, Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Rao Yingqi, courtesy name Ziwei, came from Enshi in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 幼穎悟好學，試作渾天儀，旋轉合度。

translations.literal: As a child he was clever and fond of learning; testing a armillary sphere, it turned in correct measure.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he was clever and studious; a armillary sphere he built turned with correct measure.

sentences.zh: 年十二，入邑庠，益究心經世學。

translations.literal: At twelve he entered the county school and pursued statecraft studies still more.
translations.idiomatic: At twelve he entered the county school and deepened his study of statecraft.

sentences.zh: 咸豐九年，粵寇石達開自湘、鄂犯蜀，道恩施，應祺率鄉團助城守。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xianfeng the Guangdong bandit Shi Dakai invaded Shu from Hunan and Hubei, passing Enshi; Yingqi led local militia to help defend the city.
translations.idiomatic: Xianfeng year nine, Taiping general Shi Dakai invaded Sichuan through Hunan and Hubei, passing Enshi; Rao led militia to help defend the city.

sentences.zh: 由候選訓導議敘國子監學正。

translations.literal: Through candidate director of studies he was rewarded with National University academician.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was rewarded with the rank of National University academician.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，舉於鄉，揀選知縣，援例為主事，分刑部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he passed the provincial examination, was selected as magistrate, purchased entry as a principal secretary, and was assigned to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhi year one he passed provincial exams, was selected as magistrate, bought into the Ministry of Punishments as principal secretary.

sentences.zh: 父卒，廬墓側。

translations.literal: When his father died he dwelt by the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died he mourned at the tomb.

sentences.zh: 服闋，陝甘總督左宗棠檄參軍幕。

translations.literal: After mourning, Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Zuo Zongtang ordered him to join the military staff.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning, Zuo Zongtang ordered him into his headquarters.

sentences.zh: 以克金積堡、巴燕戎格諸處功，擢知府。

translations.literal: For merit in capturing Jinjibu and Bayan Rongge he was promoted to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Merit at Jinjibu and Bayan Rongge won him promotion to prefect.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，署同州知府。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu he acted as prefect of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu year three he acted as Tongzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 時秦、晉亢旱，赤地千里，饑民洶洶，遮道不得前。

translations.literal: At that time Shaanxi and Shanxi suffered severe drought; for a thousand li the land was bare red; hungry people surged and blocked the road so he could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi and Shanxi were in severe drought; red earth stretched a thousand li; starving people blocked his path.

sentences.zh: 應祺諭之曰：「此來賑汝飢耳！

translations.literal: Yingqi told them: "I have come to relieve your hunger!
translations.idiomatic: Rao told them, "I have come to feed you!

sentences.zh: 譁變者殺無赦。」

translations.literal: Those who made uproar would be killed without pardon."
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who rioted would be killed without mercy."

sentences.zh: 乃捐俸錢為官紳倡，弛重糶禁，旬日得糧七十餘萬石，又截留他省糧運以助不繼。

translations.literal: He then donated salary as example for officials and gentry, relaxed heavy grain-sale bans, and in ten days obtained more than seven hundred thousand shi of grain, and also intercepted grain transport from other provinces to aid what was lacking.
translations.idiomatic: He donated his salary to lead officials and gentry, relaxed grain-sale bans, gathered seven hundred thousand shi in ten days, and diverted other provinces' grain shipments.

sentences.zh: 復為招流亡，定墾章，給牛種，蠲雜稅。

translations.literal: He also gathered the displaced, fixed reclamation regulations, gave oxen and seed, and exempted miscellaneous taxes.
translations.idiomatic: He resettled refugees, set reclamation rules, gave oxen and seed, and exempted miscellaneous taxes.

sentences.zh: 歲稍轉，教民興水利，勤樹植，設義倉，行保甲。

translations.literal: When the year turned slightly better he taught the people water works, urged tree planting, established charity granaries, and implemented baojia.
translations.idiomatic: When the year improved he taught irrigation, urged tree planting, opened charity granaries, and enforced baojia.

sentences.zh: 又規复豐登書院，創修府志，文化蔚興，士民為立生祠。

translations.literal: He also planned to restore the Fengdeng Academy, revised the prefectural gazetteer, culture flourished, and scholars and people built a living shrine for him.
translations.idiomatic: He restored Fengdeng Academy, revised the prefectural gazetteer, revived local culture, and the people built him a living shrine.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠疏薦應祺守絕一塵，才堪肆應，請以道府簡補。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang memorialized recommending Yingqi as utterly unstained by dust, talent fit for broad use, and asked that he be selected for circuit intendant or prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo memorialized that Rao's integrity was spotless, his talent broad, and asked that he be promoted to intendant or prefect.

sentences.zh: 十年，授甘州知府。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed prefect of Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Year ten made him Ganzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 陝西自軍興，兵差旁午，設裡局董之，凡四十一廳州縣大困。

translations.literal: Since military rise in Shaanxi, military couriers were busy and a bureau was set to manage them; all forty-one departments, prefectures, and counties were greatly distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Since the northwest wars, military courier bureaus had burdened all forty-one prefectures and departments in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 上命巡撫邊寶泉赴陝查辦，疏留應祺理其事。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Governor Bian Baoquan to go to Shaanxi to investigate; he retained Yingqi to handle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Governor Bian Baoquan to investigate Shaanxi; Bian kept Rao to handle the bureau.

sentences.zh: 應祺量道路衝僻定收支之數，分別兵流，掃浮汰冗，歲省數十萬兩。

translations.literal: Yingqi measured receipts and disbursements according to road importance, distinguished military and civilian traffic, swept floating waste and redundancy, and saved several hundred thousand taels yearly.
translations.idiomatic: Rao set receipts by road priority, separated military and civilian traffic, cut waste, and saved hundreds of thousands of taels yearly.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，抵甘州任，賑饑勸學，設織紡局、孤嫠所，革徵草之弊，复七斤一束舊章。

translations.literal: That winter he reached Ganzhou; he relieved famine, encouraged learning, established textile bureaus and shelters for widows and orphans, reformed abuses in grass collection, and restored the old rule of seven jin per bundle.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he took Ganzhou, ran famine relief and schools, opened textile mills and orphanages, reformed grass-collection abuses, and restored the seven-jin bundle rule.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遷蘭州道。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Lanzhou circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Year eleven transferred him to Lanzhou circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 瀕行，士民攀轅留行，多泣下者。

translations.literal: On departure scholars and people clung to his carriage to detain him, many weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving office, scholars and commoners clung to his carriage, many weeping.

sentences.zh: 旋署按察使。

translations.literal: Soon he acted as judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He soon acted as judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嚴搶嫠為婚之禁，擒督署差弁及鄉人楊營弁置之法。

translations.literal: He strictly forbade forcing widows to remarry, captured the governor's runners and village bully Yang Ying and punished them by law.
translations.idiomatic: He banned forced remarriage of widows and punished the governor's runners and local bully Yang Ying.

sentences.zh: 手訂清理庶獄章程，以詔群吏，視其功過而黜陟之。

translations.literal: He personally drafted regulations for clearing accumulated prison cases to instruct all officials, judging their merit and fault for promotion or dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: He drafted rules for clearing backlog cases, judged officials by results, and promoted or dismissed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 十五年，調新疆喀什噶爾道，改鎮迪道，兼按察使銜。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Kashgar circuit in Xinjiang, then Zhendi circuit, concurrently with judicial commissioner rank.
translations.idiomatic: Year fifteen sent him to Kashgar circuit in Xinjiang, then Zhendi circuit with judicial commissioner rank.

sentences.zh: 十七年，署新疆布政使；

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he acted as Xinjiang treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: Year seventeen he acted as Xinjiang treasurer.

sentences.zh: 十九年，實授。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he received substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Year nineteen confirmed the appointment.

sentences.zh: 新疆兵燹後，民物凋弊，地多荒棄。

translations.literal: After the war fires in Xinjiang, people and goods were desolate and much land lay abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: After Xinjiang's wars, population and wealth lay in ruins and much land was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 伊犁故腴壤，回屯舊八千戶，四不存一。

translations.literal: Yili was formerly fertile soil; of the old Hui farm households eight thousand, four did not remain.
translations.idiomatic: Yili had been fertile farmland; of eight thousand old Hui farming households, fewer than a quarter remained.

sentences.zh: 應祺建議伊犁將軍給新裁錫伯、索倫兵牛糧，使之屯種；

translations.literal: Yingqi proposed that the Yili general give newly demobilized Xibe and Solon troops grain and cattle for farming.
translations.idiomatic: Rao proposed that the Yili general give newly demobilized Xibe and Solon soldiers grain and cattle to farm.

sentences.zh: 給新裁察哈爾、厄魯特兵羊馬，使牧放；

translations.literal: Give newly demobilized Chahar and Olot troops sheep and horses for herding.
translations.idiomatic: Give demobilized Chahar and Olot troops sheep and horses for herding.

sentences.zh: 並招致關內災民，按丁授地，實行寓兵於農之法。

translations.literal: Also gather disaster refugees from within the passes, allot land by household, and truly implement the method of settling soldiers as farmers.
translations.idiomatic: Also recruit inland famine refugees, allot land by household, and implement true military-colonist farming.

sentences.zh: 羅布淖爾者，舊史所稱星宿海也，漢為且末、尉犁、婼羌諸國地，東西廣千六百餘裡，南北袤千里或數百里，自陽關道梗，其地遂成甌脫。

translations.literal: Lop Nur is what old histories call the Sea of Stars; in Han times it was the land of Shanshan, Weili, Ruoqiang and other states, more than 1,600 li east-west and a thousand li or several hundred li north-south; since the Yang Pass route was blocked the place became a no-man's land.
translations.idiomatic: Lop Nur was the Star Sea of old histories, Han-era territory of Shanshan, Weili, and Ruoqiang—1,600 li east-west, up to a thousand li north-south; when the Yang Pass route closed it became a vacuum.

sentences.zh: 應祺建議巡撫築蒲昌城，設英格可力善後局、卡克里克屯防局，招徠漢回客纏，通道置驛，建堡濬渠，教以耕織。

translations.literal: Yingqi proposed that the governor build Puchang City, establish the Yinggekeli Pacification Bureau and the Kaklik Frontier Defense Bureau, attract Han and Hui settlers, open roads and post stations, build forts and dredge canals, and teach farming and weaving.
translations.idiomatic: Rao proposed building Puchang City, frontier bureaus at Yinggekeli and Kaklik, attracting Han and Hui settlers, posts and forts, canals, and farming and weaving.

sentences.zh: 又請改防軍為標營，定額徵糧石每年折色之法，畫一錢法。

translations.literal: He also asked to change defense troops to banner camps, fix annual grain collection in cash conversion, and unify the money standard.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to reorganize defense troops into banner camps, fix grain collection in cash equivalents, and unify currency.

sentences.zh: 俄領事原議駐吐魯番，後求移駐省垣，將軍、巡撫難之。

translations.literal: The Russian consul had originally agreed to station at Turfan, then asked to move to the provincial capital; the general and governor found it difficult.
translations.idiomatic: The Russian consul had agreed to Turfan, then demanded the provincial capital; the general and governor resisted.

sentences.zh: 應祺謂：「此不必爭。

translations.literal: Yingqi said: "This need not be contested.
translations.idiomatic: Rao said, "That is not worth fighting.

sentences.zh: 我所應爭者，洋商稅則須與華商一律，同時議定。

translations.literal: What we should contest is that foreign merchants' tax rules must be the same as Chinese merchants, fixed at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: What we must fight for is equal tax treatment for foreign and Chinese merchants, fixed in one treaty.

sentences.zh: 新省毗連英、俄，陸路進口地不一，北道伊犁，南道喀什，應設關，各以本道為監督；

translations.literal: The new province borders Britain and Russia with many overland import points; the northern route is Yili, the southern Kashgar; customs should be set, each supervised by its circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang borders Britain and Russia with many overland trade routes—Yili in the north, Kashgar in the south; each needs a customs office under its circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 塔城、烏什、葉爾羌應設分卡，歸各道兼轄。」

translations.literal: Tacheng, Ush, and Yarkand should have branch stations under each circuit's combined jurisdiction."
translations.idiomatic: Tacheng, Ush, and Yarkand need branch stations under those intendants."

sentences.zh: 均如議行。

translations.literal: All were approved and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved all points.

sentences.zh: 南路初設領署，應祺貽書伊塔、喀什兩道曰：「交鄰之道，莫先於自治。

translations.literal: When the southern route first set consular offices, Yingqi wrote to the Yita and Kashgar circuits: "In dealing with neighbors, nothing comes before self-governance.
translations.idiomatic: When southern consulates opened, Rao wrote the Yita and Kashgar intendants: "Neighbor relations begin with governing ourselves well.

sentences.zh: 我之用人行政，使彼族聞而敬服，則遇事不至以非禮相要，此為折衝禦侮第一要義。

translations.literal: If our appointment and administration make their people hear and respect us, when matters arise they will not demand with impropriety—this is the first essential for parrying insult and resisting humiliation.
translations.idiomatic: If our administration earns respect, foreigners will not bully us—that is the first defense against insult.

sentences.zh: 飲食往還，平時貴以情誼相聯。

translations.literal: Food and drink intercourse, in normal times value linking by sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: In peacetime, bind them with hospitality and personal ties.

sentences.zh: 至華洋訴訟，必先得華民是非曲直實情而後與之爭，庶可關其口而奪之氣。

translations.literal: In Chinese-foreign lawsuits, first obtain the true right and wrong of the Chinese party and then contend with them, so you can shut their mouths and take their breath.
translations.idiomatic: In mixed lawsuits, establish the Chinese party's facts first, then argue—only then can you silence them.

sentences.zh: 一詞稍偽，彼將執以相例，而全案皆虛矣。

translations.literal: One word slightly false and they will seize it as precedent and the whole case becomes empty.
translations.idiomatic: One false detail becomes their precedent and the whole case collapses.

sentences.zh: 情以籥之，理以盾之，又其次也。」

translations.literal: Sentiment as shield, reason as spear—that is the next resort.
translations.idiomatic: Appeal to sentiment if you must, to principle if you can—that is second best.

sentences.zh: 新疆向受協餉，每苦款絀，應祺開源節流，數年庫儲逾百萬。

translations.literal: Xinjiang had always received cooperative subsidies and often suffered short funds; Yingqi opened sources and cut spending, and in several years treasury storage exceeded a million.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang had always relied on subsidies and often ran short; Rao raised revenue and cut spending until treasury reserves passed a million taels within years.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，河、湟回煽亂，蔓延甘、涼諸郡，其別股萬餘謀西竄。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the He-Huang Hui stirred rebellion, spreading through Gan and Liang prefectures; a separate band of more than ten thousand planned to flee west.
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty-one Hui rebels in He-Huang spread through Gansu and Liangzhou; more than ten thousand planned to flee west.

sentences.zh: 上命應祺署新疆巡撫，應祺檄提督牛允誠防安西、玉門諸處，拒寇境外。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Yingqi to act as Xinjiang governor; Yingqi ordered Commander Niu Yuncheng to defend Anxi, Yumen, and other places and repel the bandits outside the border.
translations.idiomatic: The court named Rao acting Xinjiang governor; he ordered General Niu Yuncheng to hold Anxi and Yumen and keep rebels outside the border.

sentences.zh: 回酋劉四伏果竄玉門之昌馬，遇允誠軍，戰數不利，盡棄輜重，逾雪山西逸。

translations.literal: The Hui chief Liu Sifu indeed fled to Changma in Yumen, met Yuncheng's army, fought several times unfavorably, abandoned all baggage, and fled west over the snow mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Hui chief Liu Sifu fled to Changma in Yumen, fought Niu Yuncheng several times, abandoned his baggage, and fled over the snowy mountains.

sentences.zh: 應祺遣參將李金良要之紅柳峽，生擒劉四伏，降其眾八千，安置於羅布淖爾，設軍鎮撫。

translations.literal: Yingqi sent Major Li Jinliang to intercept him at Hongliuxia, captured Liu Sifu alive, received the surrender of eight thousand followers, and settled them at Lop Nur with a military garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Rao sent Major Li Jinliang to Hongliuxia, captured Liu Sifu alive, accepted eight thousand surrendering followers, and settled them at Lop Nur under military guard.

sentences.zh: 同時庫車回謀起事，寧遠回亦以爭新教相仇殺，洶洶思變。

translations.literal: At the same time Kuche Hui plotted uprising and Ningyuan Hui also killed each other over the new teaching, all seething for change.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Kuche Hui plotted revolt and Ningyuan Hui fought over the new teaching, unrest boiling everywhere.

sentences.zh: 應祺皆先期撲滅，故四伏無內應，卒就殲。

translations.literal: Yingqi suppressed all in advance, so Sifu had no internal support and was finally destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Rao crushed each plot early, so Liu Sifu had no allies inside and was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其功，實授巡撫。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his merit and granted substantive appointment as governor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his service and confirmed him as governor.

sentences.zh: 應祺以新疆僻處國西北隅，密邇強俄，士卒眾而器械窳，生齒繁而司牧少，不足以固吾圉，乃購快槍萬枝於德國，而設機器廠製造子彈，奏設左右翼馬隊為游擊師。

translations.literal: Yingqi held that Xinjiang lay in the northwest corner of the state, close to powerful Russia, with many soldiers but poor arms, many people but few administrators, insufficient to secure the frontier; he therefore bought ten thousand rapid rifles in Germany and set a machine factory to make bullets, memorializing to establish left and right wing cavalry as mobile divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Rao saw Xinjiang in the northwest corner beside Russia, with many troops but poor weapons and few officials to govern them. He bought ten thousand German rifles, opened a munitions factory, and memorialized for left and right mobile cavalry divisions.

sentences.zh: 又開辦于闐、塔城金礦，墾荒田，開渠井，廣興實業，凡有利於民生者，皆次第舉。

translations.literal: He also opened gold mines at Yutian and Tacheng, reclaimed wasteland, dug canals and wells, and widely promoted enterprises beneficial to people's livelihood—all were undertaken in turn.
translations.idiomatic: He opened gold mines at Yutian and Tacheng, reclaimed land, dug canals, and promoted every enterprise that helped livelihood.

sentences.zh: 自是地利盡闢，兵備有資，較初建行省時迥異矣。

translations.literal: From this the land's advantage was fully opened, arms had resources, and compared with the beginning of the provincial system it was altogether different.
translations.idiomatic: Land was opened, arms supplied, and Xinjiang looked utterly different from the day the province was founded.

sentences.zh: 拳匪亂起，俄兵自薩馬進逼邊卡，應祺會總督魏光燾、伊犁將軍長庚仿東南各省，與各領事結互相保護之約，俄兵乃退。

translations.literal: When the Boxer turmoil arose, Russian troops advanced from Sama toward border posts; Yingqi joined Governor-General Wei Guangtao and the Yili General Chang Geng, following southeastern provinces, to conclude mutual protection treaties with each consul, and the Russian troops withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxers rose, Russian troops advanced from Sama; Rao joined Wei Guangtao and Yili General Chang Geng in mutual-protection treaties with consuls, as southeastern provinces had done, and the Russians withdrew.

sentences.zh: 議成，應祺應詔陳言，略謂：「古今中外治法務在求實。

translations.literal: When the agreement was made, Yingqi responded to the edict with a memorial, roughly saying: "Ancient and modern, Chinese and foreign governance must seek what is real.
translations.idiomatic: After the agreements he memorialized: "Chinese and foreign governance, ancient and modern, must seek what is real.

sentences.zh: 舊章非無可守，守之不以實，成法亦具文；

translations.literal: Old regulations are not without what can be kept; kept without reality, established law is also empty text.
translations.idiomatic: Old rules can work if enforced in earnest; without earnestness they are empty paper.

sentences.zh: 新法非不可行，行之不以實，良法亦虛飾。

translations.literal: New methods are not impossible to implement; implemented without reality, good law is also vain ornament.
translations.idiomatic: New methods can work if implemented in earnest; without earnestness they are mere show.

sentences.zh: 心之實不實，宜於行事之實不實驗之。」

translations.literal: Whether the heart is real or not should be tested by whether conduct is real."
translations.idiomatic: Whether the heart is sincere shows in whether deeds are sincere."

sentences.zh: 逾年，詔設武備學堂，編立常備、續備、巡警各軍。

translations.literal: After more than a year an edict established military preparatory schools and organized regular, reserve, and patrol armies.
translations.idiomatic: A year later the court founded military preparatory schools and organized regular, reserve, and patrol forces.

sentences.zh: 應祺主操練用新法，器械用新式；

translations.literal: Yingqi held that drill should use new methods and arms new patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Rao held that drill should use new methods and new weapons.

sentences.zh: 人惟求舊，必樸實勤奮久於戰陣者，方可入選。

translations.literal: Men seek the old; only those plain, diligent, and long in battle lines may be selected.
translations.idiomatic: But men must be plain, diligent veterans of real campaigns.

sentences.zh: 上疏極論之，並謂：「中國習洋操三十年，一敗於日本，再敗於聯軍，為務虛名而貽實禍之證。」

translations.literal: He memorialized fiercely, also saying: "China has practiced foreign drill for thirty years, defeated once by Japan, twice by the allied armies—proof of pursuing empty names and bringing real disaster."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized fiercely: "China has drilled in foreign style for thirty years, lost once to Japan and twice to the allied armies—proof that empty forms bring real disaster."

sentences.zh: 所言皆切中時弊。

translations.literal: His words all hit the ailments of the time.
translations.idiomatic: Every word struck the age's disease.

sentences.zh: 而尤龂龂於界約，不少遷就。

translations.literal: He was especially obstinate about border treaties and would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially stubborn on border treaties and would not yield.

sentences.zh: 帕米爾高原，國境也，有高宗御製平寇碑，立於蘇滿。

translations.literal: The Pamir plateau is national territory; there is a stele inscribed by Gaozong for pacifying bandits, erected at Suman.
translations.idiomatic: The Pamir plateau is Chinese territory; Qianlong's pacification stele still stands at Suman.

sentences.zh: 英、俄交覷其地，而俄人先竊據之。

translations.literal: Britain and Russia both coveted the place, and the Russians first seized it.
translations.idiomatic: Britain and Russia both coveted it; Russia seized it first.

sentences.zh: 應祺官布政使時，商之巡撫，以理退俄兵，遣軍戍焉。

translations.literal: When Yingqi was treasurer he discussed with the governor, used reason to drive back Russian troops, and sent troops to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: As treasurer he persuaded the governor to argue Russia down and garrison the Pamirs.

sentences.zh: 俄人悔失計，日聒於總署，要我撤兵。

translations.literal: The Russians regretted their miscalculation and daily pressed the Grand Council to demand withdrawal of troops.
translations.idiomatic: Russia regretted the move and daily pressed the Grand Council to withdraw Chinese troops.

sentences.zh: 應祺持不可，謂：「我自守門戶，其理直。

translations.literal: Yingqi held it impossible, saying: "We guard our own gate; our reason is just.
translations.idiomatic: Rao refused: "We guard our own gate; our cause is just.

sentences.zh: 我退則英必至，英來則俄又必爭，是息事而益多事也。」

translations.literal: If we withdraw the English will come; if the English come the Russians will contend again—stopping trouble only increases trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Withdraw and Britain arrives; Britain arrives and Russia contests again—yielding breeds more quarrels."

sentences.zh: 後竟如應祺言。

translations.literal: Later events proved exactly as Yingqi said.
translations.idiomatic: Events later proved him right.

sentences.zh: 坎人求租種莎車屬喇斯庫穆荒地，應祺謂：「坎本我屬，宜示懷柔。

translations.literal: Kashgaris sought to rent and farm wasteland of Lasikumu subordinate to Yarkand; Yingqi said: "The Kashgaris are originally our subjects and should be shown kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgaris sought to lease Lasikumu wasteland near Yarkand; Rao said, "They are our subjects and deserve kindness.

sentences.zh: 其在玉河卡倫外者，可允其租墾，納賦比於華人；

translations.literal: Those outside the Yarkand frontier station may be allowed to rent and reclaim, paying tax equal to Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: Those outside the Yarkand frontier post may lease land and pay tax like Chinese.

sentences.zh: 其在玉河東北屬邊內者，宜卻之，防後患。」

translations.literal: Those inside the northeast of the Yarkand River within the border should be refused to prevent later trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Those inside the northeast border of the Yarkand River should be refused to prevent future trouble."

sentences.zh: 總署與英使議界約，以坎部讓與印度，而塔墩巴什帕米爾及喇斯庫穆全境皆讓與中國。

translations.literal: The Grand Council negotiated boundary treaties with the English minister, ceding the Kashgar district to India while Tadunbash Pamir and all Lasikumu were ceded to China.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Council negotiated with Britain, ceding Kashgar districts to India while Tadunbash Pamir and all Lasikumu went to China.

sentences.zh: 應祺抗言：「喇本我地，不得謂之讓。」

translations.literal: Yingqi protested: "Lasikumu was originally our land and cannot be called cession."
translations.idiomatic: Rao protested: "Lasikumu was always ours—it is not a cession."

sentences.zh: 而俄人轉謂中國以喇地讓與英人，利益宜均，以兵威相脅。

translations.literal: The Russians then said China had ceded Lasikumu to the English and benefits should be equal, threatening with military force.
translations.idiomatic: Russia then claimed China had ceded Lasikumu to Britain and demanded equal benefit, threatening force.

sentences.zh: 應祺飭屬嚴備邊，而以議租原委及議約界限詳諭之，俄人始無辭。

translations.literal: Yingqi ordered subordinates to prepare the border strictly and explained in detail the original lease negotiation and treaty limits, and the Russians finally had no words.
translations.idiomatic: Rao fortified the border and explained the lease and treaty limits in detail until Russia had no reply.

sentences.zh: 應祺官西疆久，闢地安民，屢請建官設治以資鎮撫。

translations.literal: Yingqi governed the western frontier long, opening land and settling people, repeatedly asking to establish officials for control and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Rao governed the western frontier for years, opening land and settling people, repeatedly asking for new administrative units.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，复疏言：「新疆自光緒四年改建行省，土地日闢，戶口日繁，原設州縣，轄境遼遠，非增設府廳，不足治理。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he again memorialized: "Since Xinjiang was changed to a province in the fourth year of Guangxu, land daily opens and households daily increase; the original prefectures and counties have jurisdictions too vast and distant—not enough for governance.
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty-eight he memorialized again: "Since Xinjiang became a province in Guangxu year four, land and population have grown until old counties are too vast to govern.

sentences.zh: 西四城喀什噶爾道：疏勒州為極邊重要，請升為府；

translations.literal: The four western cities of the Kashgar circuit: Shule Prefecture is of extreme border importance—please promote to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kashgar circuit's four western districts, Shule on the farthest border should become a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 距府百八十里之排素巴特地屬唐伽師城，改為伽師縣；

translations.literal: Paisuabad one hundred eighty li from the prefecture was Tang Gashi territory—change to Gashi County.
translations.idiomatic: Paisuabad, 180 li from the prefecture, was Tang-era Gashi—make it Gashi County.

sentences.zh: 莎車地廣而腴，英商麕集，請升為府：府南為澤勒普善河，增設澤普縣；

translations.literal: Yarkand's land is broad and fertile and English merchants gather—please promote to prefecture: south of the prefecture is the Zelepu River—add Zepu County.
translations.idiomatic: Yarkand's fertile lands attract English merchants—promote it to prefecture; south along the Zelepu River add Zepu County.

sentences.zh: 府西南色勒庫爾為古蒲犁國，實坎巨提出入要路，又與英、俄接壤，請設蒲犁分防通判；

translations.literal: Southwest Selekur was ancient Puli, the vital route for Kashgaris entering and leaving, also bordering Britain and Russia—please establish a Puli sub-prefect for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest Selekur, ancient Puli and the Kashgaris' main route, bordering Britain and Russia, needs a Puli sub-prefect.

sentences.zh: 距于闐縣四百里之洛浦莊，增設洛浦縣；

translations.literal: Luopu village four hundred li from Yutian County—add Luopu County.
translations.idiomatic: Luopu village, 400 li from Yutian, becomes Luopu County.

sentences.zh: 嗎喇巴什廳為古巴爾楚地，改為巴楚州。

translations.literal: Maralbeshi Department was ancient Balchu—change to Bachu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Maralbeshi department, ancient Balchu, becomes Bachu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東四城阿克蘇道：溫宿州為南疆要衝，請升為府；

translations.literal: The four eastern cities of the Aksu circuit: Wensu Prefecture is the southern frontier's vital point—please promote to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Aksu circuit's four eastern districts, Wensu, the southern frontier's hinge, should become a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊城巡檢升為溫宿縣；

translations.literal: The old city patrol inspector promoted to Wensu County.
translations.idiomatic: The old-city patrol post becomes Wensu County.

sentences.zh: 距縣四百八十里之柯爾坪，增設柯坪縣丞；

translations.literal: Kelpin four hundred eighty li from the county—add Kelpin county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Kelpin, 480 li away, gets a county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 焉耆府南六百三十里布古爾分防巡檢為古之輪台，請分設輪台縣；

translations.literal: Bugur sub-prefect six hundred thirty li south of Yanqi Prefecture was ancient Luntai—please separately establish Luntai County.
translations.idiomatic: Bugur sub-prefect, 630 li south of Yanqi, was ancient Luntai—establish Luntai County.

sentences.zh: 卡克里克縣丞，其地為古婼羌國，改設婼羌縣；

translations.literal: The Kaklik county magistrate's territory was ancient Ruoqiang—change to Ruoqiang County.
translations.idiomatic: Kaklik county magistrate's territory, ancient Ruoqiang, becomes Ruoqiang County.

sentences.zh: 庫車廳土地廣沃，請改為州；

translations.literal: Kuche Department's land is broad and fertile—please change to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Kuche department's broad fertile land should become a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 州南沙爾雅增設沙雅縣。

translations.literal: South of the prefecture Sharya—add Shaya County.
translations.idiomatic: South of the prefecture along Sharya add Shaya County.

sentences.zh: 北路阜康縣之濟木薩縣丞，富庶逾於縣，舊驛名孚遠，升為孚遠縣；

translations.literal: The Jimusa county magistrate of Fukang County was wealthier than the county; the old post name was Fuyuan—promote to Fuyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: Jimusa magistrate under Fukang was richer than the county; the old post Fuyuan becomes Fuyuan County.

sentences.zh: 距吐魯番二百四十里之闢展巡檢地為古鄯善國，升為鄯善縣；

translations.literal: The Zhan post inspector's land two hundred forty li from Turfan was ancient Shanshan—promote to Shanshan County.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan post inspector's land, 240 li from Turfan, ancient Shanshan, becomes Shanshan County.

sentences.zh: 昌吉縣所屬之呼圖壁巡檢向收錢糧，請改為縣丞。

translations.literal: The Hutubi patrol inspector subordinate to Changji County collected grain tax—please change to county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Hutubi patrol under Changji, which collected grain tax, becomes a county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 計升設府三，改直隸州二，增通判一、縣九、縣丞二。」

translations.literal: In total three prefectures promoted, two direct prefectures changed, one sub-prefect added, nine counties added, two county magistrates added."
translations.idiomatic: In all: three new prefectures, two upgraded departments, one sub-prefect, nine counties, two county magistrates."

sentences.zh: 又奏增設鄉試中額二名，會試中額一名，暨各府學官學額，先後皆議行。

translations.literal: He also memorialized to add two provincial examination quotas and one metropolitan quota, and school quotas for each prefecture—all were approved in turn.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for two more provincial examination seats, one metropolitan seat, and school quotas for each prefecture—all approved.

sentences.zh: 是年，調安徽巡撫，行抵哈密，病卒，賜卹如例。

translations.literal: That year he was transferred to Anhui governor; reaching Hami he died of illness; mourning rites followed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was transferred to Anhui governor; at Hami he died; mourning followed regulation.

sentences.zh: 惲祖翼，字叔謀，江蘇湖陽人。

translations.literal: Yun Zuoyi, style name Shumou, was a native of Huyang, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Yun Zuoyi, courtesy name Shumou, came from Huyang in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 同治三年舉人。

translations.literal: He became a provincial graduate in the third year of Tongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed provincial exams in Tongzhi year three.

sentences.zh: 以知縣累至道員，再攝武昌道。

translations.literal: Through magistrate he rose to circuit intendant and twice acted as Wuchang circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from magistrate to circuit intendant and twice acted as Wuchang intendant.

sentences.zh: 教匪王覺一約期起事，祖翼時筦營務，乘夜率親兵掩捕之。

translations.literal: The sectarian Wang Jueyi fixed a date to rise; Zuoyi then managed camp affairs and led personal troops by night to seize him.
translations.idiomatic: Sectarian leader Wang Jueyi set a date to rebel; Yun, managing camp affairs, led troops by night and captured him.

sentences.zh: 總督塗宗瀛疏保祖翼有濟變才，光緒十五年，授督糧道。

translations.literal: Governor-General Tu Zongying memorialized recommending Zuoyi's talent for managing crisis; in the fifteenth year of Guangxu he was appointed grain transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Tu Zongying recommended Yun's crisis talent; Guangxu year fifteen made him grain transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 調漢黃德道，兼江漢關監督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Han-Huang-De circuit, concurrently supervising the Jianghan Customs.
translations.idiomatic: He became intendant of Han-Huang-De and supervised Jianghan Customs.

sentences.zh: 以襄河漲發易壞舟，創設襄樊報水電，樹牌鳴鉦，各船備禦，水至遂無患。

translations.literal: Because the Xiang River's rise easily damaged boats, he created the Xiang-Fan river-report telegraph, set signs and sounded gongs, and each boat prepared against flood so when water came there was no trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xiang floods wrecked boats, he created the Xiang-Fan river telegraph, posted signs and gongs, and equipped every boat so floods did no harm.

sentences.zh: 晉按察使，擢浙江布政使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to judicial commissioner and then Zhejiang treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to judicial commissioner, then Zhejiang treasurer.

sentences.zh: 祖翼以州縣徵糧照舊折價，近年錢貴銀賤，民力不支，乃重定銀價，設櫃徵收，不得假手書役，人稱其惠。

translations.literal: Zuoyi held that prefectures and counties collected grain tax at old cash conversion; in recent years cash was dear and silver cheap and the people's strength could not bear it; he therefore reset the silver price, set counters for collection, and did not allow clerks to intervene—people called it a benefit.
translations.idiomatic: County grain tax still used old cash rates while silver had fallen and copper risen, crushing taxpayers. Yun reset silver prices, opened collection counters, and barred clerks—people called it a blessing.

sentences.zh: 尤盡心水利，於嘉興開泖河，疏港建閘，以資蓄洩。

translations.literal: He especially devoted himself to water works; at Jiaxing he opened the Pao River, dredged harbors and built sluices for storage and discharge.
translations.idiomatic: He devoted himself to hydraulics: at Jiaxing he opened the Pao River, dredged harbors, and built sluices.

sentences.zh: 於杭州浚上塘河，臨平、喬司等處農田三十餘萬畝皆獲灌溉之利。

translations.literal: At Hangzhou he dredged the Shangtang River; more than three hundred thousand mu of farmland at Linping, Qiaosi, and other places all received irrigation benefit.
translations.idiomatic: At Hangzhou he dredged the Shangtang River, irrigating more than three hundred thousand mu around Linping and Qiaosi.

sentences.zh: 上虞南塘舊以土築，水至輒決。

translations.literal: Shangyu's South Dike was formerly built of earth and broke whenever water came.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyu's South Dike had been earthen and failed whenever floods came.

sentences.zh: 採眾議，改建石塘千一百丈，始免水患。

translations.literal: Following public discussion he rebuilt a stone dike of 1,100 zhang and finally escaped flood harm.
translations.idiomatic: On public advice he rebuilt 1,100 zhang of stone dike and ended the floods.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，北京拳亂報至，祖翼獨起抑阻。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year when Beijing's Boxer turmoil was reported, Zuoyi alone rose to restrain it.
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty-six, when Beijing's Boxer news arrived, Yun alone moved to restrain the movement.

sentences.zh: 匪陷江山、常山，衢民復毀教戕官，英國欲以兵艦赴浙。

translations.literal: Bandits took Jiangshan and Changshan; Quzhou people again destroyed churches and killed officials; Britain wished to send warships to Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits seized Jiangshan and Changshan; Quzhou people wrecked churches and killed officials; Britain threatened warships.

sentences.zh: 祖翼亟遴員馳往鎮撫，獲真犯抵償，潛消兵釁。

translations.literal: Zuoyi quickly selected officials to rush to pacify, obtained the true criminals for compensation, and quietly eliminated the threat of troops.
translations.idiomatic: Yun sent officials to pacify the region, secured real culprits for compensation, and quietly averted war.

sentences.zh: 會兩江、湖廣總督與各國訂約保護南疆，電詢浙省。

translations.literal: When the governors-general of the two Jiang and Huguang made treaties with all nations to protect the southern regions, they telegraphed to ask Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Liangjiang and Huguang governors-general made mutual-protection treaties with foreign powers, they wired Zhejiang for assent.

sentences.zh: 巡撫劉樹棠方臥病，祖翼即迳電以浙省附約，人心以安。

translations.literal: Governor Liu Shutang was then ill in bed; Zuoyi directly wired that Zhejiang joined the treaty and popular hearts were calmed.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Liu Shutang lay ill; Yun wired directly that Zhejiang joined the treaty, calming public fear.

sentences.zh: 旋擢巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to governor.

sentences.zh: 以浙省防練各營積弊，疏請整飭，略言：「浙省水陸防練各營數踰制兵，陸續添募，餉實不敷。

translations.literal: Because Zhejiang's defense and drill camps had accumulated abuses, he memorialized for rectification, roughly saying: "Zhejiang's land and water defense and drill camps exceed regulated numbers; men were added in succession and pay truly fell short.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's defense and drill camps were riddled with abuse; he memorialized for reform: "Camp rolls exceed regulation while pay falls short.

sentences.zh: 而統領各營哨，不顧操練緝捕為何事，汲汲焉唯浮冒剋減，食弊自肥。

translations.literal: Yet the officers commanding camps and squads, regardless of drill and pursuit, were only eager to inflate and embezzle and fatten themselves on abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Officers ignore drill and pursuit, inflating rolls and embezzling pay.

sentences.zh: 術愈出而愈奇，勇日雜而日弱，盜日防而日多。

translations.literal: Methods grow more ingenious yet troops daily mix and grow weaker; bandits are daily guarded yet daily multiply.
translations.idiomatic: Tricks multiply while troops grow weaker; bandits are 'guarded' yet multiply.

sentences.zh: 今將蕩滌宿垢而作新之。

translations.literal: Now we shall wash away old filth and make anew.
translations.idiomatic: Now we must wash away old corruption and begin anew.

sentences.zh: 立法自上，責在督撫。

translations.literal: Establish law from above; responsibility lies with governor-general and governor.
translations.idiomatic: Law must come from above; governors bear the responsibility.

sentences.zh: 臣任事即通飭各營，與之更始。

translations.literal: When I took office I immediately notified all camps to begin anew with them.
translations.idiomatic: On taking office I immediately ordered every camp to start afresh.

sentences.zh: 以後如有貪劣將弁，仍敢浮冒剋減，決不姑容。

translations.literal: Hereafter if greedy and inferior officers and men still dare to inflate and embezzle, I will certainly not spare them.
translations.idiomatic: Any officer who still inflates rolls or embezzles will not be spared.

sentences.zh: 擬先勵其廉恥，而兼課其材武。

translations.literal: I plan first to encourage their sense of shame and also test their martial talent.
translations.idiomatic: I will first appeal to their honor, then test their martial skill.

sentences.zh: 一面飭州縣查保甲，辦團練，以輔制兵之不逮；

translations.literal: On one side order prefectures and counties to inspect baojia and organize militia to supplement what regular troops cannot reach.
translations.idiomatic: I will order counties to inspect baojia and train militia to cover what regular troops cannot.

sentences.zh: 一面遴委廉幹道府，酌帶哨勇，分往浙東西，抽點名糧，認真校閱。

translations.literal: On another side select honest and capable circuit intendants and prefects, with chosen squad braves, to divide between east and west Zhejiang, check rolls and grain pay, and truly review drill.
translations.idiomatic: I will send honest intendants with picked troops through eastern and western Zhejiang to audit rolls and inspect drill.

sentences.zh: 遇有大股盜匪，督率營縣搜拿，務絕根株。

translations.literal: When large bandit gangs appear, lead camp and county forces to search and seize, striving to uproot them entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Large bandit bands will be hunted by camp and county forces until uprooted.

sentences.zh: 總期合散為聚，化惰為勤，堪備一日之緩急。

translations.literal: In general gather the scattered into concentration, turn laziness into diligence, fit for a day's emergency.
translations.idiomatic: The goal is to gather scattered men, turn laziness into discipline, and be ready when crisis comes.

sentences.zh: 雖然，營衛小疾，疏解足矣，受病既深，斷非猛劑不治。

translations.literal: Although camp guard is a small ailment, gentle dissolving is enough; when the disease is already deep, it cannot be cured without strong medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Minor camp ailments might yield to gentle remedies; this disease is too deep for anything but strong medicine.

sentences.zh: 天下之病，無一不根於利。

translations.literal: The empire's ailment has no root but profit.
translations.idiomatic: The empire's sickness has one root: profit.

sentences.zh: 統領營哨，聞見已慣，謂夫督撫所能操以繩其下者，撤之而已，參之而已。

translations.literal: Officers commanding camps and squads, long accustomed, think what governors-general can wield to bind subordinates is only dismissal or impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: Camp officers long accustomed think governors can only dismiss or impeach them.

sentences.zh: 撤之則又顧而之他，參之則已飽颺而去；

translations.literal: Dismiss them and they look elsewhere; impeach them and they leave well fed.
translations.idiomatic: Dismiss them and they find new posts; impeach them and they leave with full purses.

sentences.zh: 且未幾而又夤緣開復矣，未幾而以將才調用矣。

translations.literal: Before long they pull strings for restoration; before long they are transferred as military talent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they pull strings for reinstatement; soon they are praised as military talent elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 惟督以峻法，務去泰甚，庶有以振暮氣而戢貪風。

translations.literal: Only stern law from the governor, striving to remove excess, may somewhat rouse the evening spirit and curb greedy wind.
translations.idiomatic: Only stern law from governors, cutting excess, can rouse morale and curb greed.

sentences.zh: 或震於各國一時之強，幾謂全恃火器，不知其本原仍在臨財廉，與士卒同甘苦。

translations.literal: Some are awed by foreign nations' momentary strength and nearly think everything depends on firearms, not knowing the root still lies in integrity toward wealth and sharing hardship with soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Some, awed by foreign guns, forget that integrity with money and sharing soldiers' hardship remain the root.

sentences.zh: 否則未戰先潰，火器徒以齎寇，直自伐耳。

translations.literal: Otherwise before battle they collapse first and firearms only enrich the enemy—truly self-destruction.
translations.idiomatic: Without that, armies collapse before battle and rifles merely arm the enemy—self-defeat.

sentences.zh: 可否請旨飭下兵、刑各部，採臣治亂用重之議，嗣遇將弁贓證確鑿者，分別輕重，嚴定參革、追繳、倍罰、斬絞之例，庶軍心一振，於時局或有裨益。」

translations.literal: May I request an edict to the War and Punishments ministries to adopt your servant's proposal to use heavy measures in disorder, so that hereafter when officers' and men's corruption is proven, distinguishing light and heavy, strict rules for impeachment, dismissal, recovery, double fines, and decapitation are fixed—perhaps military hearts will be roused and the times somewhat helped.
translations.idiomatic: May the throne order the War and Punishments ministries to adopt severe rules: when corruption is proven, fix punishments from impeachment and fines to execution—perhaps then army morale will rise and the times improve.

sentences.zh: 疏入，詔飭各省著為令。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, an edict admonished all provinces to make it regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial reached Beijing; an edict made his rules binding on every province.

sentences.zh: 未幾，丁母憂歸。

translations.literal: Before long he entered mourning for his mother and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He soon left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 卒，卹如例。

translations.literal: He died; mourning rites followed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: He died; mourning followed regulation.

sentences.zh: 浙人請立祠祀之。

translations.literal: Zhejiang people requested a temple to sacrifice to him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang people asked for a temple in his honor.

sentences.zh: 論曰：疆吏當承平時，民生吏治，要在因地制宜而已。

translations.literal: The commentary says: When frontier officials face peaceful times, people's livelihood and official administration depend on adapting measures to local conditions.
translations.idiomatic: The historians comment: In peaceful times frontier governors succeed by adapting policy to local conditions.

sentences.zh: 日昌、寶第皆以尚嚴著績效。

translations.literal: Richang and Baodi both achieved results through severity.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Richang and Bian Baodi both won fame through strict rule.

sentences.zh: 宗瀛、廕霖飾之以儒術，亦後先稱治。

translations.literal: Zongying and Yinlin adorned this with Confucian learning and were also praised for good governance in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Zongying and Yu Yinlin added Confucian learning and were likewise praised for good government.

sentences.zh: 培敬有為有守，崧駿兄弟所至盡職，寶泉勵清操，祖翼能濟變，並有可稱。

translations.literal: Peijing had ability and constancy; the Song brothers performed their duties wherever they went; Baoquan upheld pure integrity; Zuoyi could manage crisis—all have merit to mention.
translations.idiomatic: Li Peijing was capable and steadfast; the Song brothers served faithfully; Bian Baoquan kept pure integrity; Yun Zuoyi handled crises—each deserves mention.

sentences.zh: 至應祺官關隴、新疆垂四十年，邊地初闢，治績爛然，實心實政，其勞亦不可沒雲。

translations.literal: As for Yingqi, who held office in Shaanxi-Gansu and Xinjiang nearly forty years, when the frontier was first opened his achievements blazed; with sincere heart and sincere policy, his labor also cannot be erased.
translations.idiomatic: Rao Yingqi governed Shaanxi-Gansu and Xinjiang for nearly forty years, opening the frontier with blazing achievement—sincere policy whose labor must not be forgotten.
